analysis: The exposure change produced macro validation HR@10 of 0.4725, improving on the reported 0.460 reference by 0.0125, but remaining below the 0.480 experimental target and 0.505 baseline. Per-category HR@10 was 0.485 for Movies_and_TV, 0.485 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.395 for Electronics, and 0.525 for CDs_and_Vinyl. The host reported successful execution and 821.77 allocated GPU-seconds. This supports increased training exposure as useful for this configuration, but does not establish underfitting or explain the remaining baseline gap. Per-category reference metrics and training diagnostics were not supplied, so category-specific improvements and stopping behavior cannot be determined.
code_summary: The model combines candidate-conditioned attention over item-history embeddings with two causal Transformer blocks and a final-state sequential readout. Learned tanh gates control contextual and sequential contributions; scoring includes recency-bucket attention biases and item biases. Training retains sampled cross-entropy with 16 training-history-excluded negatives, embedding regularization, AdamW, and gradient clipping. The isolated change uses uniform replacement sampling for 200 full batches per completed epoch, with fresh prefix sampling and augmentation on every draw, and logs optimizer steps and examples. Validation checkpoint selection, stopping controls, all four dataset routes, and predictor generation remain unchanged.
